The '''Tahonda Ruins''' are a [[tauren]] village that long ago came to ruin and slipped beneath the sands of the [[Shimmering Flats]].

Little to no information was known about this village. The ruins were inhabited by Saltstone [[basilisk]]s, which might have been the reason why it was abandoned. Other evidence points to an attack by hostile forces: two sets of three parallel tears in the leather of one of the buildings.
